description: React components for donation-related UI, including FAQ, support benefits, thank you messages, and donation info, with internationalization and feature toggles.

methods.name: CtaText
methods.description: Component rendering call-to-action donation text with internationalized content.

methods.name: ThankYouMessage
methods.description: Component displaying a thank you message with optional donation encouragement.

methods.name: OtherWaysToSupport
methods.description: Component with links to other ways to support donations.

methods.name: FaqItem
methods.description: Component for individual FAQ item with toggle for expansion.

methods.name: DonationFaqText
methods.description: Component rendering a list of FAQ items related to donations.

methods.name: SupportBenefitsText
methods.description: Component displaying support benefits, optionally for supporters page.

methods.name: CurrentInitiativesText
methods.description: Component listing current initiatives supported by donations.

methods.name: GetSupporterBenefitsText
methods.description: Component showing benefits for supporters or donors.

methods.name: ModalBenefitList
methods.description: Component listing benefits shown in donation modal, with accessibility toggle.
